caption:
You're afraid your faith is too weak to count. But what if your faith was never something you produced? (Galatians 2:20 devotional)

"I have been crucified with Christ" is not an achievement you pulled off — it's His long persuasion finally taking hold in you. Like Abraham, whose belief was the end of a road God had been walking toward him for years, your faith is His gift and His work, reaching back further than you know. And His work does not fail.
